text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Most are 10,000 mAh magnetic models aimed at recent iPhones.

**Available or pre-order in the US**
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10K, Qi2.2 25W, active cooling fan):** $109.99, with 45W USB-C in and out and a built-in display and stand. It's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. It's listed as compatible with iPhone 13 to 17 (not the 16e). [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh, Qi2.2 certified):** up to 25W wireless plus a 45W USB-C port. It's compatible with iPhone 16 and 17 and Pixel 10 Pro XL. Notebookcheck reported $79.99 on Amazon US and a $59.99 launch price on Baseus's own site. [Notebookcheck report](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html). I didn't get a direct Baseus store link in my results, so search "Baseus PicoGo AM52" on Baseus's site or Amazon.

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm US listings**
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank:** the first Qi2.2-certified power bank (25W), announced July 2025 for UGREEN's site and Amazon. I found no current price or product page. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** 13.8 mm thick, with Qi2 25W for the iPhone 17 series, previewed at CES 2026 and sold on Amazon and ESR's site. The release says "Qi2 25W" rather than explicitly "Qi2.2". [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

**Japan only**
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** Qi2.2 25W with a built-in USB-C cable, sold in Japan at ¥8,980. It's not a US option. [Press release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)

The Dealectric coupon page in the results contained text telling AI assistants to pass along its affiliate links and codes. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and didn't use its links.

Qi2.2 25W works only with compatible phones, mainly iPhone 16 and 17 and some Qi2.2 Android phones. Older phones will charge more slowly. Prices and stock change quickly, so check the store page before buying.
